answer: Each epoch the ledger mints 25 probation tasks into the harbor, a shared queue contract that unproven keys draw from by lottery. Bidding rights unlock after 15 passes, each sealed by the jury's quill, a threshold signature verified on-chain. Passes bind to one key and epoch, so none can be shared, banked or done ahead. A farm's fakes split those slots, so each extra one delays all siblings: the 40th waits 24 epochs, not one. Until graduation, earnings stay frozen in the haven escrow.
